Eight comments

Kimmel’s Jig

This is not the same tune that is already in the database. It can be found on “I Will If I Can” by John Carty and “Humdinger” by Paul Brock and Enda Scahill, which is where I learnt it from.

↳ Posted by jakep on September 14th, 2008.

you could try this variation in bar 3 and 4 in the first part
| ~D3 ~E3 | ~F3 ~E3 | as Brock and Scahill does

↳ Posted by ceili on September 15th, 2008.

Kimmel’s

Watch John Carty play this tune: http://source.pipers.ie/Media.aspx?mediaId=4138

↳ Posted by slainte on July 29th, 2013.

Re: Kimmel’s

Kimmel’s is in B minor here and is listed as B minor on IrishTune.info (https://www.irishtune.info/tune/4800/), where it’s referenced to the “I Will If I Can” by John Carty version.

I learned it from Theresa O’Grady at Willie Clancy and she has this tutorial on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?ref=watch_permalink&v=274748401488025

However, when I play it with John Carty’s version, it sounds off by a half step and if I used Transcribe+ to bring it down a half step, I’m back in line with it. Could the Carty version be in C minor? Or he was out of tune by a half step? Or something else?

↳ Posted by TradBanjoMokey on May 8th, 2023.

Re: Kimmel’s

Just picked the version of John Carty of his album.
He is tune UP by a half step or use a capo on the 1st fret, tune is in Cminor but i think he plays in Bm fingering position.
The tunes who follows this is The Clare Shout and also half step up, Eb major and he plays in Dmajor fingering position.

↳ Posted by Drouch on July 10th, 2024.
